summary.text: Karen Varley is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Ray Sorensen.
She ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost to Sorensen, receiving 27.7 percent of the vote, and Ballotpedia lists the Iowa Federation of Labor, AFL-CIO among her 2026 endorsements.
